title: PAR-07/S8 over-budget DataStorage link refusal
scope: Exercise the aggregate linked-payload cap at the exact boundary and on the first byte over
Assert that a rejected link publishes no partial entity state
Assert that an already-linked payload and accounting remain stable and the rejected record is reported orphaned
Reuse the existing graph-preservation test and CTest

localCodeInspection: src/intern/dwgreader.cpp::linkDataStorage checks the cumulative copy-byte budget before allocating/publishing the candidate entity payload
tests/graph_preservation_tests.cpp already verifies cumulative in-budget copies and idempotent repeated linking but not the exact-cap then over-cap refusal sequence
method.limitations: The vector constructs a typed DataStorage section in memory and tests local payload-link accounting. It does not claim producer-authored DWG conformance, ACIS semantics, or consumer support.

behavior: A record whose payload exactly equals PAYLOAD_BLOB_SECTION_CAP links successfully and is byte-identical to its source record.
A following one-byte record is refused; its entity retains the original empty carrier and modeler flags.
The earlier entity remains linked, cumulative bytes stay at the cap, linkFailures increases once, and the refused record is counted/reported as orphaned.
No test registration or production behavior changed.

validation.commitBlocker: The task environment exposes .git as read-only and the shared worktree contains extensive unrelated user changes; no files were staged.

decision.nextAction: Audit local DataStorage record-index behavior against ODA §24.2.2 and current generated tests. Do not modify duplicate-record precedence without authoritative format evidence; then proceed to the next ready PAR-07/S8 item.
